visualCharacteristics.summary: Single embedded video (YouTube, Vimeo or MP4) inside an article, with an optional poster image and title; also a full-width looping decorative banner video.

contentPattern.structure: One row: optional title/heading text, optional poster picture, and the video link (YouTube/Vimeo/MP4). With a poster the embed loads on click; without one it loads when scrolled into view.
